# Fourier Transform

## Frequency domain

<ul style="list-style-type: '① ';">
<li>The convolution in time domain is the multiplication in frequency domain:</li>
<span>
```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[>=latex, thick]
  \node[draw, minimum width=2.2cm, minimum height=1cm] (sys) {$LTI$};

  \draw[->] (-3,0) -- (sys.west);
  \draw[->] (sys.east) -- (3,0);

  \node[above] at (-3,0) {$x(t)$};
  \node[above] at (3,0) {$y(t)=x(t) * h(t)$};
  \node[below] at (sys.south) {$h(t)$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
</span>

<span>
```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[>=latex, thick]
  \node[draw, minimum width=2.2cm, minimum height=1cm] (sys) {$LTI$};

  \draw[->] (-3,0) -- (sys.west);
  \draw[->] (sys.east) -- (3,0);

  \node[above] at (-3,0) {$X(\omega)$};
  \node[above] at (3,0) {$Y(\omega)=X(\omega) \cdot H(\omega)$};
  \node[below] at (sys.south) {$H(\omega)$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
</span>
</ul>

<ul style="list-style-type: '② ';">
<li>More convenient.</li>

E.g. sine wave

Time domain:
```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[->] (-1, 0) -- (6, 0) node[right] {$x$};
  \draw[->] (0, -1) -- (0, 1) node[above] {$y$};
  \draw[scale=0.5, domain=0:12, smooth, variable=\x, blue] plot ({\x}, {sin(deg(\x))});
\end{tikzpicture}
```

Frequency domain:
```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    >=latex,
    axis/.style={->, thick, black},
    curve/.style={thick, blue},
    marker/.style={thick, magenta},
    labelpink/.style={magenta}
]

\begin{scope}[yshift=3.2cm]
    \draw[axis] (0,0) -- (6.3,0) node[right] {$\omega$};
    \draw[axis] (0,0) -- (0,1.8) node[above] {$A$};

    \draw[marker] (1.6,0) -- (1.6,1.2);
    \fill[magenta] (1.6,1.2) circle (1.3pt);
    \node[labelpink, below] at (1.6,-0.1) {$\omega_0$};
    \node[labelpink, right] at (1.78,1.12) {$A_0$};
\end{scope}

\begin{scope}
    \draw[axis] (0,0) -- (6.3,0) node[right] {$\omega$};
    \draw[axis] (0,0) -- (0,1.8) node[above] {$\varphi$};

    \draw[marker] (1.6,0) -- (1.6,1.0);
    \fill[magenta] (1.6,1.0) circle (1.3pt);
    \node[labelpink, below] at (1.6,-0.1) {$\omega_0$};
    \node[labelpink, right] at (1.78,0.92) {$\varphi_0$};
\end{scope}

\end{tikzpicture}
```
</ul>

<ul style="list-style-type: '③ ';">
<li>More direct.</li>

<!-- **③** More direct. -->

Time domain:
```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    >=latex,
    axis/.style={->, thick, black},
    wave/.style={thick, green!60!black},
    op/.style={font=\Large}
]

% ---------- first signal ----------
\begin{scope}[xshift=0cm]
    \draw[axis] (0,-1) -- (0,1);
    \draw[axis] (-0.2,0) -- (3.4,0) node[right] {$t$};
    \draw[domain=0:3.14, smooth, variable=\x, green!60!black] plot ({\x}, {0.6*sin(deg(2*\x))});
    \draw[blue, dashed] (0,0.6) -- (0.78,0.6);
    \node[blue, left] at (0,0.6) {$A_1$};
    \node[green!60!black, below] at (1.6,-0.85) {$\omega_1$};
\end{scope}

% plus sign
\node[op] at (4.3,0.1) {$+$};

% ---------- second signal ----------
\begin{scope}[xshift=5.2cm]
    \draw[axis] (0,-1) -- (0,1);
    \draw[axis] (-0.2,0) -- (3.4,0) node[right] {$t$};
    \draw[domain=0:3.14, smooth, variable=\x, green!60!black] plot ({\x}, {0.15*sin(deg(10*\x))});
    \draw[blue, dashed] (0,0.15) -- (0.157,0.15);
    \node[blue, left] at (0,0.15) {$A_2$};
    \node[green!60!black, below] at (1.6,-0.85) {$\omega_2$};
\end{scope}

% equals sign
\node[op] at (9.5,0.1) {$=$};

% ---------- resulting signal ----------
\begin{scope}[xshift=10.5cm]
    \draw[axis] (0,-1) -- (0,1);
    \draw[axis] (-0.2,0) -- (3.4,0) node[right] {$t$};
    \draw[domain=0:3.14, smooth, variable=\x, green!60!black] plot ({\x}, {0.6*sin(deg(2*\x)) + 0.15*sin(deg(10*\x))});
\end{scope}

\end{tikzpicture}
```

\begin{tikzpicture}[

Fourier Series: Every periodic function can be represented by a series of (co)sines.

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    >=latex,
    axis/.style={->, thick, black},
    signal/.style={thick, green!60!black},
    marker/.style={thick, magenta},
    labelpink/.style={magenta},
    note/.style={blue}
]

% ---------- time-domain signal ----------
\begin{scope}[xshift=0cm]
    % axes
    \draw[axis] (-0.5,0) -- (5.5,0) node[right] {$t$};
    \draw[axis] (0,-0.3) -- (0,1.8);

    % periodic ramp / sawtooth
    \foreach \k in {0,1,2,3,4} {
        \draw[signal] (\k,0) -- ({\k+1},1.5);
        \draw[signal] ({\k+1},1.5) -- ({\k+1},0);
    }

    % period marker
    \draw[<->, signal] (0,-0.55) -- (1,-0.55);
    \node[signal, below] at (0.5,-0.55) {$T_0$};

    % omega_0 equation
    \node[labelpink] at (2.5,-1.05) {$\omega_0 = \displaystyle\frac{2\pi}{T_0}$};
\end{scope}

% ---------- Fourier series arrow ----------
\node[note] at (6.9,0.85) {F. S.};
\draw[axis] (6.5,0.5) -- (7.5,0.5);

% ---------- frequency-domain spectrum ----------
\begin{scope}[xshift=8.5cm]
    % axes
    \draw[axis] (-0.5,0) -- (5.5,0) node[right] {$\omega$};
    \draw[axis] (0,-0.3) -- (0,1.8);

    % spectral lines
    \draw[marker] (1,0) -- (1,1.2);
    \draw[marker] (2,0) -- (2,0.9);
    \draw[marker] (3,0) -- (3,0.7);
    \draw[marker] (4,0) -- (4,0.55);
    \draw[marker] (5,0) -- (5,0.45);

    % labels
    \node[labelpink, below] at (1,-0.1) {$\omega_0$};
    \node[labelpink, below] at (2,-0.1) {$2\omega_0$};
    \node[labelpink, below] at (3,-0.1) {$3\omega_0$};
    \node[labelpink, below] at (4,-0.1) {$4\omega_0$};
    \node[labelpink, below] at (5,-0.1) {$5\omega_0$};
\end{scope}

\end{tikzpicture}
```

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    >=latex,
    axis/.style={->, thick, black},
    signal/.style={thick, green!60!black},
    marker/.style={thick, magenta},
    labelpink/.style={magenta},
    note/.style={magenta}
]

% ---------- time-domain signal ----------
\begin{scope}[xshift=0cm]
    % axes
    \draw[axis] (-0.5,0) -- (5.5,0) node[right] {$t$};
    \draw[axis] (0,-0.3) -- (0,1.8);

    \draw[signal] (0,0) -- (5,1.5);
    \draw[signal] (5,1.5) -- (5,0);

    % period marker
    \node[signal, below] at (2.5,-0.25) {$T_0 \to \infty$};

    % omega_0 equation
    \node[labelpink] at (2.5,-1.25) {$\omega_0 \to 0$};
\end{scope}

% ---------- Fourier series arrow ----------
\node[note] at (6.9,0.85) {F. T.};
\draw[axis] (6.5,0.5) -- (7.5,0.5);

% ---------- frequency-domain spectrum ----------
\begin{scope}[xshift=8.5cm]
    % axes
    \draw[axis] (-0.5,0) -- (5.5,0) node[right] {$\omega$};
    \draw[axis] (0,-0.3) -- (0,1.8);
    \draw[domain=0:5, smooth, thick, variable=\x, magenta] plot ({\x}, {1.5*exp(-0.2*\x)});

    % spectral lines
    \foreach \k in {1,...,40} {
        \draw[magenta] (\k/8,0) -- ({\k/8},1.5*exp(-0.2*(\k/8)));
    }

    % labels
    \node[labelpink, below] at (1/8,-0.25) {$\omega_0$};
\end{scope}

\end{tikzpicture}
```


Why decompose into sinusoids?
